summary: Syonis is a Legendary Necrosis Shadow hero featured in a Selected Summon banner running from October 31 to November 5. Official ratings classify him as S-tier in Support and PvE, and A+ in Survival. His passive skill reduces enemy Defense by up to 50% in front of him based on his Enlightenment. His battle skill gives all Shadow allies +30% Attack for 8 seconds and boosts Shadow Energy generation. His ultimate pulls the highest-Attack enemy into an energy drain zone, dealing increased damage based on target lost HP.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.note: Provides up to 50% aura Defense shred based on Enlightenment, grants +30% Attack to Shadow allies, and pulls the highest-Attack enemy into an energy drain zone.

tips: Build high Enlightenment on Syonis to maximize his passive Defense shred up to the 50% cap.
Pair Syonis with Shadow damage dealers to fully utilize his +30% Attack buff and Shadow Energy boost.
